mapper.select: select id, user_id, media_id, liked, wished, watched, rating, liked_time, wished_time, watched_time, rating_time from km_user_media_action where user_id = #{userId} and media_id = #{mediaId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into km_user_media_action (user_id, media_id, liked, wished, watched, rating, liked_time, wished_time, watched_time, rating_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{mediaId}, ifnull(#{liked},'0'), ifnull(#{wished},'0'), ifnull(#{watched},'0'), #{rating}, #{likedTime}, #{wishedTime}, #{watchedTime}, #{ratingTime}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update km_user_media_action set rating = #{rating}, rating_time = #{ratingTime}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and media_id = #{mediaId}
